verdict.rationale: Fin exposes a real, documented Agent API and broader Intercom REST API (auth-gated, live per probes) plus an official MCP server, letting AI-native users call Fin and its data programmatically, but key orchestration endpoints (Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, Escalate) are explicitly 'Preview API version only,' and no public OpenAPI spec was found, so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: GA (non-preview) parity for orchestration/config actions, a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, evidence that UI-only features (e.g., View exports, guidance/procedure building) are fully API-controllable.
